analysis: Supplementary Figure S1 Age+Gender+DurationOfDisease-adjusted partial correlations with SDMT and MSFC-SDMT using one global 182-cell Bonferroni family
s1_caption: Supplementary Figure S1. Age-, recorded-gender-, and disease-duration-adjusted absolute partial correlations between lesion metrics and EDSS, T25FW, 9HPT-D, 9HPT-ND, MSPro, SDMT, and MSFC-SDMT. Asterisks indicate p_adjusted < 0.05 after one global Bonferroni correction across all 182 correlation cells (14 whole-brain and 168 displayed cells; p_adjusted = min[p_raw x 182, 1]).

multiple_testing.strategy: One global family spanning all seven clinical outcomes and all whole-brain and displayed correlation cells
multiple_testing.interpretation: A single Bonferroni correction across 182 valid cells controls the global family-wise error rate at 0.05 for the complete correlation analysis.
